dialogues.speaker: Amadhiah
dialogues.text: That instrument, huh? You can have it.

dialogues.speaker: Amadhiah
dialogues.text: It belongs to wayfarers who travel like the wind. But it's been by my side for too long.

dialogues.speaker: Amadhiah
dialogues.text: Please let it sing in the woods, I guess that won't let the poet lady's goodwill go to waste...
